# Templates

| Template | Use |
|---|---|
| [Design document](design-doc.md) | One page, before building anything a review would cover ([when a review is required](../architecture/coe-charter.md#when-a-review-is-required)) |
| [ADR](adr.md) | One decision, its alternatives, its evidence, and the strongest objection; the [repository's ADRs](../architecture/adr/README.md) follow it |
